messages.subject: R805 knowledge archive complete
messages.body: Saved a 1,597-word read-only archive comparing direct column-major B, persistent packed/VNNI B, and transient SLM/subgroup conversion, with seven pinned sources. The sources establish subgroup/layout and DPAS operand contracts, but API forms alone do not prove runtime lowering, GPU execution, or relative cost; no Arc performance result or winner was found. Remaining work is coordinator review/indexing and a future owned IR/ISA/timing comparison after actual GEMM evidence exists.
